items.title: Hal Galper interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 27, 2022
items.q: Cannonball could play anything and Nat could play anything but it was basically a blues band

ctx.x: Yeah. Almost always. I don’t think Junior Mance wrote but I’m not sure about that. Bobby Timmons wrote for them, you know. But I think I made him — I’ve said this before — I think I made a mistake in judgment in the tunes that I gave the band because I was — this is really hard to explain but I’m a greedy son of a bitch. I just want to play as much as possible because I know that school you know. But I gave them — my tunes were too modern. I mean I’ve got — Cannonball could play anything and Nat could play…
Okay. Well I have something — you want to play a little name that tune?
